accepted_gaps.title: Pressure-resolved global inventory
accepted_gaps.statement: No single framework combines compartment volumes, absolute cells, and pressure-corrected activity.

accepted_gaps.title: Composition-function link
accepted_gaps.statement: Taxonomic and gene inventories do not establish which taxa are active in situ.
accepted_gaps.constraint: Pair molecular profiles with direct rate or isotope evidence.

accepted_gaps.title: Compatible upscaling
accepted_gaps.statement: Global cell abundance and local rates are often sampled at incompatible geochemical conditions.
accepted_gaps.constraint: Upscale only after depth, lithology, redox, and pressure stratification.

accepted_gaps.title: Pressure artifact
accepted_gaps.statement: Decompression can alter apparent bulk activity and community interpretation.
accepted_gaps.constraint: Use paired in situ-pressure and decompressed measurements.

rejected_inferences.inference: All deep cells are equally active.
rejected_inferences.reason: Standing biomass, viability, and metabolic flux are distinct.

rejected_inferences.inference: A gene proves a globally important process rate.
rejected_inferences.reason: Functional potential needs calibration against activity and substrate flux.
Pressure response is taxon and process dependent.
